summary: Round 2 re-validation of the Testing Strategy after fixes. All previously-flagged gaps are now mapped to explicit test scenarios: both HIGH (paused-drain L307; blocked-bot-during-waiting L308-309), all four MED (legit loop-resend L310; {user.first_name} render + parse_mode escaping L311; in-range-but-invalid button L304; currentStepId-mismatch L303), both LOW (backfill double-run idempotency L313; answerCallbackQuery 5xx best-effort L315), and the new IDOR cross-subscriber test (L301-302). Every stated AC (lines 368-376) maps to at least one scenario. Pyramid balance remains sound: unit-heavy on pure logic (copyOf, validateSteps, callback_data parse, reply_markup mapping, drift, stepById), integration covering every engine/webhook/DTO/index seam with deterministic Clock + Testcontainers + MockWebServer, and a single Playwright happy-path with vitest for the rest of the frontend. Two minor coverage observations remain; neither blocks pass.

findings.gap: Positive analytics assertion not stated as its own scenario. AC L209 'натиск кнопки записує подію funnel_button_clicked + lastButtonClicked' appears in the AVP (L333) but no Integration-test bullet explicitly asserts that a SUCCESSFUL resumeOnCallback writes the funnel_button_clicked event AND lastButtonClicked on the execution. The park-on-reply bullet (L295) asserts branch advance only; the IDOR bullet asserts the opposite (execution did NOT move), so the positive write path is implied but unanchored.
findings.suggestion: Add an Integration bullet: 'valid click -> resumeOnCallback advances branch AND asserts funnel_button_clicked event persisted (funnelId/executionId/step/button, ids-only, no PII per Decision 9) AND execution.lastButtonClicked set.' Assertions: captured event type==funnel_button_clicked with correct executionId; execution.lastButtonClicked == clicked button; event payload carries no from.first_name/username.

findings.gap: Strict URL-scheme rejection asserted only positively. Unit list (L286) and Task 4 (L426) cover 'URL http(s)' / strict URI parse, but Decision 10 (L211-219) and the scheme-injection risk (L353) call out rejecting javascript:/data:/tg://, leading-whitespace, startsWith-bypass and empty-host; no negative scenario enumerates these in the test list.
findings.suggestion: Add to validateSteps unit (or FunnelControllerIT Task 4) negative cases asserting 422 funnel_broken_edge / reject for url in {'javascript:alert(1)','data:text/html,...','tg://resolve?...',' https://x' (leading ws),'httpsx://evil' (startsWith bypass),'http://' (empty host)}. Assert each is rejected, not merely that valid http(s) passes.
